updates.before:
# Caroline
- Transgender woman; began transitioning approximately 2020 (as of 2023-06-09)
- Involved with LGBTQ+ community; attends support groups
- Actively pursuing counseling/mental health career focused on serving trans people
- Attended LGBTQ+ counseling workshop on 2023-06-23
- Attended LGBTQ+ pride parade (late June/early July 2023); felt proud, grateful, and accepted
- Joined a mentorship program for LGBTQ youth; mentors a transgender teen just like her
- Planning an LGBTQ art show with her paintings for August 2023
- Creates paintings inspired by LGBTQ+ spaces and community experiences
- Values empathy, self-expression, and personal growth
- Motivated by her own journey and support received to help others
- Passionate about creating safe, inviting spaces for people to grow
- Building a library of children's books (classics, multicultural stories, educational books) for when she has kids
- Pursuing adoption as a single parent (as of 2023-05-25)
- Attended adoption council meeting on 2023-07-14; inspired and determined to adopt
- Researching LGBTQ+-inclusive adoption agencies
- Moved from home country approximately 2019 (as of 2023-06-09)
- Experienced a difficult breakup prior to June 2023
- Has a strong support network of friends and family who provided love, guidance, and acceptance during her transition
- Attended an LGBTQ conference on 2023-07-10; felt welcomed and accepted
